root_cause: The focus trap's default delayInitialFocus option defers setting initial focus to the next tick, leaving focus on the triggering button when the test asserts focus immediately after opening the dialog.
repair_strategy: Disable delayInitialFocus in the focus trap configuration so initial focus is applied synchronously upon activation.

edits.before: const trap = createFocusTrap('#address-dialog', { onDeactivate: () => { backdrop.hidden = true; } });
edits.after: const trap = createFocusTrap('#address-dialog', { onDeactivate: () => { backdrop.hidden = true; }, delayInitialFocus: false });

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users will receive immediate focus on the first usable field (street input) when the address dialog opens, satisfying focus order expectations.
functional_risks: Altering delayInitialFocus may affect edge cases where external code expects a delayed focus, but the trap is used solely for this dialog.
verification_requirements: After activating the dialog, focus must be on #street.
Pressing Tab should move focus sequentially through #street, #save, #cancel, then wrap.
Pressing Escape must close the dialog and return focus to the #open button.
Saving an address with or without a street must update the status correctly.
